geometry.note: Point for approximate location; Polygon for known affected area

deaths_reported.note: Number of deaths reported. null if unknown.

integration_pipeline.proximity_analysis: Compute distance from each incident point to all 653 village centroids
integration_pipeline.modulation_approach: When verified disaster history is available, incidents within 2km of a village centroid will be flagged as 'has_historical_incident: true' and the incident count/severity will be added as context fields
integration_pipeline.tier_impact: Disaster history does NOT automatically change tier assignment. It is a context field for SDMA analyst review.
integration_pipeline.disclaimer: Disaster history integration requires officially verified data from USDMA/NDMA. Unverified or media-sourced incident records should NOT be used to modify village classifications.
